name: I Am Pathetic
source:
A short visual novel about Lisa, a 27-year-old woman who has hit rock bottom in nearly every aspect of her life. Now, she is having a difficult discussion with her girlfriend, Marie, who has reached her breaking point—tired of constantly trying to fix Lisa’s problems while feeling dragged down herself.

[From [url=https://hito-games.itch.io/i-am-pathetic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于丽莎的短篇视觉小说，丽莎是一位27岁的女性，她生活的几乎各个方面都陷入了谷底。现在，她正在与女友玛丽进行一场艰难的讨论，玛丽已经达到了崩溃的边缘——厌倦了不断地试图解决丽莎的问题，同时又感到自己被拖累。

[来自[url=https://hito-games.itch.io/i-am-pathetic]Itch.io[/url]]
